categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Xunjiexing Technology Corp. Ltd primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs). Their product offerings include a wide range of PCB types such as HDI boards, high-frequency boards, high-speed boards, thick copper boards, metal substrates, flexible boards, and rigid-flex boards. The company provides one-stop services from prototype to mass production, catering to various stages of product lifecycle and customer needs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed numerous proprietary core technologies including selective local nickel-gold plating, HDI board production, thick copper board manufacturing, high-frequency board processing, server board production, flexible and rigid-flex board technologies, and high-precision impedance control. They emphasize advanced manufacturing techniques such as laser imaging, mechanical controlled drilling, resin plugging, and multi-layer lamination. The firm also integrates intelligent manufacturing and automation systems to enhance production efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Xunjiexing serves a diverse customer base across multiple industries including automotive electronics (smart cockpits, ADAS, charging stations), computer and communication (5G antennas, servers, switches, optical modules), smart consumer devices (wearables, smart home appliances, drones), intelligent security (surveillance cameras, facial recognition), robotics, medical devices (ventilators, monitors), and new energy sectors (photovoltaic inverters, battery management). Their customers include well-known domestic and international enterprises such as Hikvision, Dahua, and Mindray.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing facilities in Shenzhen, Xinfeng, and Zhuhai. It actively expands its market presence internationally, targeting Europe, the United States, Japan, and South Korea through participation in global electronics exhibitions and overseas sales teams. Export sales are mainly conducted via trading partners, with key export destinations including Germany, the UK, and the US.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xunjiexing operates mainly in the midstream segment of the PCB supply chain, focusing on PCB manufacturing from prototype to mass production. It extends its business chain by investing in downstream SMT assembly services through strategic investments, enhancing its one-stop service capability from PCB fabrication to assembly and delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D in high-growth sectors such as servers, optical modules, automotive electronics, AI hardware, and 5G/6G communications. It invests heavily in developing advanced PCB technologies including multi-layer HDI, thick copper, high-frequency, and flexible-rigid boards. The firm also focuses on intelligent manufacturing, engineering automation, and digital transformation to improve production efficiency and customer service. Patent applications and technology breakthroughs are actively pursued to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of PCB products to downstream electronic product manufacturers and supplemented by sales through trading partners. The company signs framework contracts with major customers and recognizes revenue upon delivery and acceptance of products. It also derives income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Within the domestic PCB industry, Xunjiexing ranks 78th among the top 100 Chinese PCB companies and is recognized as a leading enterprise specializing in prototype and quick-turn PCB services. It competes with major domestic players like DeepSouth Circuit, XingSen Technology, and Chongda Technology, especially in high-end and specialized PCB segments. The company leverages its one-stop prototype-to-mass production service model and technological capabilities to differentiate itself in a fragmented and competitive market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 474.6 million, a 2.26% increase year-over-year, but recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.97 million due to underutilized capacity and intense price competition. Total assets grew by 10.09% to RMB 1.14 billion. The company’s R&D investment accounted for 6.77% of revenue, reflecting sustained commitment to innovation. Cash flow from operating activities improved significantly by 142.8%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xunjiexing emphasizes its unique value proposition of providing multi-variety, small-batch, high-level, and short-lead-time PCB solutions tailored to customer product development cycles. Its one-stop service from prototype to mass production reduces customer development time and risk. The company’s advanced manufacturing technologies, comprehensive product portfolio, and intelligent production capabilities enable high-quality, cost-effective, and timely delivery. Strong customer relationships and flexible production management further enhance its competitive differentiation.
